A key can attest only after a 90-day lock of 5 USDC sent from its own exchange withdrawal address. Depositor matches key one-to-one, so 50 clones need 50 funding histories and 250 USDC frozen a quarter before one vote weighs anything.

Each clone also burns 8 dollars of gas, so the farm sinks 650 dollars into funds frozen until January, and one cluster flag takes it all.

Tenants pay a deposit to prove they stay through spring; a velvet rope closes on anyone holding nothing in escrow. An opal sets its fire under pressure held for years, and the voyage home costs more than the ticket out.
